purpose: A stock change made in Shopify admin reaches ReCart through the read-only Shopify reference sync and revises the open recovery proposal.

versions.summary: The 2-in USB-C Interface with Loopback could not be found when the order was packed. Enough stock is available to fulfil the original items, so no change is needed.

The 2-in USB-C Interface with Loopback could not be found when the order was packed. Replacing only that item fails with every in-stock alternative, so connected parts change too. The proposed setup uses the 2-in USB-B Interface with Loopback, the USB-B to USB-A Cable 1 m and the USB-A to USB-C Host Adapter in place of the 2-in USB-C Interface with Loopback and the USB-C to USB-C Cable 1 m. The new total is $422.28, $45.36 more than the original order, within the buyer's $450.00 limit.

correction.detail: The proposal.revised events in this record carry reason 'catalog_changed', but both revisions were caused by the Shopify stock changes shown in watched_stock (the sync log reads 'stock changed in Shopify: 67707300151390 -> 0'). Cause: the re-planning job was de-duplicated per merchant and a re-queued job kept the payload of the first (catalog) sync. Fixed after this recording by keying the job per merchant and cause; tests/platform/api.test.ts now asserts reason 'inventory_changed'. The versions, outcomes, stock counts and totals above are unaffected.
